title: Ambience loop
description: Seamless background loops: forest, rain, cave drips, tavern murmur, engine room. Stereo, crossfaded so it repeats without a seam, quieter loudness target.
prompt_template: {prompt}{style}, continuous steady ambience with no sudden events. Length: {length} seconds
prompt_guide: Describe the place and its layers: the bed (wind, rain, room tone), the textures (leaves, drips, distant voices) and the space. Avoid one-off events (a single thunderclap, a door slam) - they repeat audibly in a loop; make those separate SFX. Example: 'Quiet forest at dawn with birds chirping, soft wind through leaves, distant stream flowing'.
